innerCanvas.title: Your sky
innerCanvas.introTitle: Discover the constellation of your moment.
innerCanvas.introText: Tell us how you feel right now. CONFIA transforms your answers into a unique constellation and brings it closer to one of the 88 constellations in the sky.
innerCanvas.questionTitle: How do you feel right now?
innerCanvas.scaleHelp: Do not look for the perfect answer. Use 0 when you do not feel it and 10 when it is strongly present.
innerCanvas.resultTitle: This was created from how you feel right now.
innerCanvas.tapArtwork: Tap the artwork to reveal the emotional focus points that helped create it.
innerCanvas.savedAutomatically: Automatically saved to your Inner Gallery.
innerCanvas.gallerySubtitle: Each artwork represents a different moment of you. Tap one to explore it again.
innerCanvas.emptyGallery: You do not have any saved artworks yet.
innerCanvas.deleteConfirm: Do you want to delete this artwork?
innerCanvas.homeSubtitle: Discover the constellation of your moment
innerCanvas.silverHint: Record all 7 days this week to reveal your Silver piece.
innerCanvas.goldHint: Record 20 days this month to reveal your Gold piece.
innerCanvas.silverUnlocked: Your Silver piece for this week has been unlocked.
